payload.friendly_name: ASN.1 Tree Delete, Copy and Paste
payload.purpose_context: crex users editing BER/DER structures can currently only delete or insert one element at a time in the ASN.1 tree. This mission adds Shift+Up/Down marking of multiple elements, deletion of the marked range, and copy/paste of whole ASN.1 subtrees so restructuring documents becomes fast and keyboard-driven.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let users mark, delete, copy and paste ASN.1 elements in the tree pane with keyboard shortcuts.
